name: System Load
author: Jon
description: One dial for how hard the machine is working, and the numbers behind it on hover or click

barWidget.description: A single strain gauge driven by whichever of CPU, memory, disk I/O or temperature has run out first, with per-resource meters, rates and top processes in the panel, with an option to pin the gauge to one metric.

schema.label: Gauge style
schema.description: arc for a 270-degree dial, bar for a flat fill

schema.label: Sample interval (open)
schema.description: Seconds between samples while the panel is open; the panel also walks the process table at this rate

schema.label: Sample interval (closed)
schema.description: Seconds between samples while only the bar gauge is visible

schema.label: Metric shown on the gauge
schema.description: Auto follows whichever of CPU, memory, disk I/O or heat is highest.
